protocol.description: FailMem Single-Fault Channel Temporary Blockage Pilot Protocol

obstacle_channel.geometry_rationale: Positioned directly between landmark cylinders (-1.1, -1.1) and (-1.1, 0.0), reducing corridor clearance below robot width (0.38m) to physically occlude south passage.

C1_continuous_blockage.name: Continuous Obstacle Blockage
C1_continuous_blockage.protocol_notes: If Nav2 finds an alternate detour and arrives, record it honestly as incomplete blockage without altering data.

C2_temporary_blockage_retry.name: Temporary Obstacle Blockage (Observe -> Remove -> Retry)
C2_temporary_blockage_retry.protocol_notes: Obstacle is spawned before initial navigate. Upon initial failure/timeout, observe action is executed, obstacle is deleted via /delete_entity, costmap is allowed to update, and retry action is dispatched with replayed parameters.
